verdict.rationale: Attio documents a public JSON REST API backed by a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1 spec. That spec covers objects, records, lists and webhooks, and is supported by filtering/sorting, SQL queries and an official MCP server for managing the workspace via AI, so core data operations are reachable programmatically. Nothing documents API parity with the UI, and major UI surfaces have no evidenced API coverage: the Workflows builder and its agents, reporting dashboards, call recording/intelligence, and admin settings such as enabling the Deal object. missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity commitment, API coverage of workflows/reporting/call intelligence/admin settings, independent corroboration of parity.
